title: Literary Design of Ephesians 5:3-6
caption: <bp-cite>Ephesians 5:3-6</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Ephesians (2019).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary" sidebar-color="blue">
      <group>
        <verse number="3" /> But sexual immorality
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and all impurity
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        or greedy desire,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary" sidebar-color="tan">
      <group>
        should not be named among y’all,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary" sidebar-color="orange">
      <group>
        as is fitting for holy ones,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary" sidebar-color="blue">
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> also obscenity
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        or foolish talk
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        or inappropriate humor;
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary" sidebar-color="tan">
      <group>
        such things have no place,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C'" type="secondary" sidebar-color="red">
      <group>
        but rather grateful thanksgiving.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A''" type="secondary" sidebar-color="blue">
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> For y’all should surely know this:
      </group>
      <group>
        that no sexually immoral
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        or impure
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        or greedy person
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        (who is an idolator)
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B''" type="secondary" sidebar-color="tan">
      <group>
        has an inheritance in the kingdom of the Messiah and of God.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="4" sidebar-value="D" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="6" /> Let no one deceive you with empty words. Because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
